[Unit]
Description=باب رزق - Auto Blog System
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/babrz/automation/1
ExecStart=/opt/babrz-blog-venv/bin/python3 /var/www/babrz/automation/1/scheduler.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=60
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
[Unit]
Description=باب رزق - Telegram Jobs Agent
After=network.target postgresql.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/babrz/automation/4
ExecStart=/opt/babrz-venv/bin/python3 main.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
[Unit]
Description=khalijah Auto Publisher — Blog + FB + TG
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/khalijah/automation
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 khalijah_publisher.py --server --hour 6
Restart=always
RestartSec=60
StandardOutput=append:/var/log/khalijah-auto.log
StandardError=append:/var/log/khalijah-auto.log
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
